description: Open (or reattach to) your isolated workspace on a fleet. exec, read_file and write_file use it automatically, and open one on an unguarded default fleet when none exists, so call this explicitly only to pick a fleet or image, or for a guarded fleet. On a guarded fleet you must first ask the user and get their explicit agreement; only then set `confirm` to the fleet name.

confirm.description: Guarded fleets only: the fleet name, set only after the user explicitly agreed. Never set it on your own.

context.description: Context name. Omit to use the default.

credentials.description: Host-mode fleets: narrow the session to these credential names (a subset of those the runner holds). Omit to use all.

fleet.description: Fleet name. Omit to use the default.

image.description: Image from the fleet allowlist. Omit for the fleet default.

labels.description: Runner labels the workspace must land on.

name: workspace_open
